messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Country Leadership, Government Relations, ESG & Strategic Partnerships
messages.body:
Dear Omer,

I am reaching out because your leadership of Robert Walters' Saudi Arabia business and your work across senior commercial and executive search mandates align closely with the GCC transition I am pursuing.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, social performance and executive advisory within a major gold-mining operation.

I am targeting Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director or Representative, Executive Director and VP-track appointments across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and the wider GCC. My strongest fit sits at the intersection of country leadership, external affairs, government relations, ESG, strategic partnerships, infrastructure, natural resources, energy transition and industrial operations.

I am internationally mobile, open to expatriate and residential assignments, and available on 30 days' notice. My GCC-focused executive CV is attached for your consideration for suitable current or confidential mandates.

Preferred reply address: ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
https://ragunauthramsaroop.com/
https://www.linkedin.com/in/ragunauth-ramsaroop/
